correctness.rationale: Directed n-bit shift-and-append de Bruijn arcs and closed incoming radius-t balls are fixed exactly. Each pair of vertices sharing the first n-1 bits has identical positive-step predecessor sets, requiring at least 2^(n-1) code vertices. The literal witness selector integers 0x73bf1b6f59ffee7f for (7,4) and 0x407fbfff1fbf6bff579f7bffedef7aff77f75bfffbfb7ffffdfd7feffefe7b0f for (9,5) select exactly one member of each prefix pair. Independently reconstructed all 128 and 512 incoming-ball signatures and checked every signature nonempty and distinct; exact minima are 64 and 256. Finite exhaustive proof is sufficient for these two pairs only.
